getAmountInUsd(address,uint256).details: Used by EswapMarginHook.isLiquidatable() and closePosition().      Normalizes by the TOKEN's decimals (mirrors src/PriceFeedL1.sol), so      cross-decimal pairs (e.g. WETH 18 / USDC 6) are valued correctly:      USD = amount_raw * price18 / 10**tokenDecimals.

getTwapPrice(address).details: Used by EswapMarginHook as the "TWAP" for the V4-spot circuit-breaker.      Chainlink is already a time-weighted / aggregated price, so no separate      TWAP contract is needed for this purpose.

params.decimals_: Decimals of the feed answer (8 for most USD feeds)

getAmountInUsd(address,uint256).notice: Returns the USD value (18-decimal) of `amount` RAW token units.

getTwapPrice(address).notice: Returns the latest Chainlink oracle price normalised to 18 decimals.

setPriceFeed(address,address,uint8).notice: Register a Chainlink USD feed for a token.
